display.name: Bun SQLite
display.description: Bun's built-in bun:sqlite baseline over the shared SQLite schema and seed data; file-backed temp database with journal_mode=WAL

fair.tuning: WAL journal, synchronous=NORMAL, temp_store=MEMORY, read-only connections (query_only=ON)

sql_variant: hand-written SQL through bun:sqlite `Database.query()`, which compiles and caches one prepared statement per call site; every statement is hoisted to module scope and executed once before LISTENING. POOL CAVEAT: bun:sqlite is synchronous and Bun is single-threaded, so a query occupies the thread until it returns and additional handles would add no concurrency. This family therefore declares pool=1 honestly rather than opening 8 idle connections to match the rusqlite SQLite family's pool=8; the two families are not pool-comparable, only contract-comparable. Same query shapes as the built-in rusqlite targets, including the GROUP BY aggregate on /orders-with-details and the two-round-trip order-details form

display.name: Drizzle ORM SQLite
display.description: Drizzle ORM RC on Bun's built-in bun:sqlite driver with prepared statements and the shared SQLite schema; file-backed temp database with journal_mode=WAL

fair.tuning: WAL journal, synchronous=NORMAL, temp_store=MEMORY, read-only connections (query_only=ON)

sql_variant: drizzle-orm query builder on every route, each query built once at startup via .prepare() and warmed before LISTENING; dates are `integer` columns so they stay epoch milliseconds like the built-in SQLite targets.
